title: A delegated agent credential, as listed (GET /api/_a2app/credentials). Never carries the token.

principal.description: the principal the agent acts for

agentName.description: the name the agent gave when it asked for access

scopes.description: as granted (`*` allowed). Every request is further limited to what the principal may do at that moment.

task.description: set on a task credential: it dies when that task reaches a terminal state
